history.text: George III and Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz are crowned King and Queen, respectively, of the Kingdom of Great Britain.
history.title: George III
history.description: King of Great Britain and Ireland from 1760 to 1820

photo.title: File:Beach of Cape Fiolent, Crimea.jpg
photo.caption: Beach of Cape Fiolent during the storm at sea. Cape Fiolent in Crimea is of ancient Jurassic origin. Upper Miocene lava and carbonate intrusions on heavily eroded Jurassic foundation.
photo.creator: Vyacheslav Argenberg

culture.text: A preliminary version of the Emancipation Proclamation is released by Abraham Lincoln.
culture.title: Emancipation Proclamation
culture.description: Executive order by U.S. president Abraham Lincoln freeing slaves in the South
